description: The email conversations in the domain inbox, newest first, one per thread: who wrote, to which address, subject, answered or not. domain or address narrow it; unansweredOnly leaves out what was answered. A connected domain moving its DNS here for email shows its progress too: nameservers, live MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Free.
name: list_domain_mail
title: List domain inbox email
